exam_scheme.note: The Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) Admission Test is conducted annually across India for admission to its prestigious undergraduate programmes — Bachelor of Statistics (Hons) at ISI Kolkata and Bachelor of Mathematics (Hons) at ISI Bengaluru — as well as Master of Statistics (M.Stat), Master of Mathematics (M.Math), MS in Quantitative Economics (MSQE), M.Tech in Computer Science, and Junior Research Fellowships (JRF). The entrance examination is held on a single day in two mandatory sessions: the Forenoon Session consists of a Multiple Choice Question paper (Test Code UGA / PGA: 30 questions, 120 marks, 120 minutes) testing advanced mathematical aptitude. The Afternoon Session consists of a Descriptive Subjective paper (Test Code UGB / PGB: 8 questions requiring rigorous mathematical proofs and problem solutions, 120 marks, 120 minutes). Only candidates meeting qualifying thresholds in the forenoon MCQ paper have their descriptive paper evaluated. Candidates qualifying the written test appear for a personal interview before final selection. All admitted students receive full monthly government stipends (₹5,000/month for UG, ₹8,000/month for PG, ₹37,000/month for JRF) plus annual contingency grants.
